newsitem.title: USA: Sega cuts prices on Saturn video games.
newsitem.headline: Sega cuts prices on Saturn video games.

text.p: Sega Enterprises Ltd's Sega of America unit said on Wednesday it had cut the price of its video games to a range between $19.99 and $59.99, eliminating its $69.99 price point.
In addition, Sega has increased retailer margins by up to 4.0 percent on software between $29.99 and $49.99.
The move resulted in lower prices on over 20 titles for the Sega Saturn game player including "Panzer Dragoon II," "World Series Baseball," "BUG!," "NBA Action" and more, it said.
